label: Ecommerce ads against analytics
note: One month, one time zone. Display prospecting is the real outlier at about 47%, and the other campaigns are fine.

label: Roofing lead gen, French headers
note: Semicolons, "7 815,40 $" amounts and repeated campaign names. Merge the repeats, drop the total row and map columns by hand; overall about 85.6% is normal.

label: EU against US consent
note: EU sessions are low because visitors decline analytics, not because of bad clicks. Do not cut EU spend on this alone.

label: Analytics against server logs
note: Run it twice, mapping first GA and then the server log as the sessions column. Clicks reach the server (about 106%) but GA records about 47%, which points to tagging or consent, not accidental clicks.

label: Black Friday, same time zone
note: Ad platform and analytics use the same time zone, and the result is healthy at about 89%.

label: Black Friday, different time zones
note: Every campaign sits at a similar 68 to 76%, including brand. That even drop points to a day-window mismatch, not bad traffic.

label: Tiny volumes and a zero-click row
note: Ignore rows with a handful of clicks and flag the zero-click row. A red overall banner would be an overreaction.
